articulation.label: open
articulation.alt: open: /oʊ/ → /p/ → /ə/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
